answer: Ask every grader to publish a short reason with each score and pay only for reasons that later survive review. A sybil ring can copy a number easily, but writing fifty distinct, accurate reasons for fifty fake keys costs real work each time, and reused reasons are easy to cluster. Honest graders already think before they score, so the extra line costs little. Each reason goes into a vault of past judgments that future audits can replay, and a ring's thin, matching notes stand out like saffron on a white plume.
